chapter.heading: A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
Behold, bless
ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah,That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.

Lift up
your hands to the sanctuary,And bless ye Jehovah.

Jehovah bless
thee out of Zion;Even he that made heaven and earth.
